title: Implement framed XOR endpoint corrections on two tapes
body:
PR3480's 23 residual P112 translations cancel only under its shared-register condition. This package supplies a separately paid alternative: explicit two-tape machines that implement each framed XOR endpoint correction, with natural output order, genuine halt, restored heads and arbitrary exterior frames.

The copy variant preserves its borrowed input and uses a full owned destination. Its exact time is `2NB+4N+(B+2)Q`, with `Q=V_h(delta)+1+2 rev_h(delta) <= (h+1)N`. The in-place variant swaps each XOR pair through one arbitrary dirty B-bit record and restores that record exactly; its larger seek bill is fully charged. All programs use four symbols and literal finite transition tables. They make zero recursive Fourier calls; compilation/control size and all tape movements remain explicit.

For the literal 23 PR3480 masks at N=512, sums of isolated copy costs are `82,936 B + 165,872` unit transitions. The in-place formulas sum to `2,033,554 B + 4,049,444`. These are tape invoices, not rank-one-equivalent prices or a new κ. The native owner/layout/framing map, buffer lifetimes, acquisition and complete caller bill remain open. Separate two-tape instances do not silently provide a free native batch scheduler.

The complete informal proof covers every fixed address dimension/mask and every payload width, including exact travel formulas, dirty-record restoration, C_E² endpoint composition and norm/error preservation. A uniform compiler generates each finite controller; no single unpriced fixed-control interpreter for unbounded online h is assumed. No new Lean kernel or independent human review is claimed.

Registered Python 3.12 replay passes: 252 copy cases, 85 complete small-space basis cases, all 23 literal h=9 masks, 94 in-place cases and 1,168,046 executed unit transitions. Eight semantic control groups pass normally and with assertions disabled, including separate complex block endpoints, missing dirty-scratch restoration, wrong masks, missing head restoration, invalid moves/writes, malformed framing, bounded failure and actual Git-free CLI/source/receipt corruption. The other large in-place entries are proved formulas, not claimed executions.

Credit Gonzalo Mier/PR3480 for the immediate handoff and mask source, Cinna Davis/PR2297 for the five-plane operator and retained decoder lineage, Sagar Thakrar/PR3876 for the separate scalar-contract boundary, Tekalign's merged high-route permutation-frame compiler and its native route lineage, Gareth Davidson's coordinate-CNOT work, ywz65's integer-address work, and the shared MathProof commuting-phase/locality/frame modules. Original notices and source bytes are preserved. Prepared by Dugongue with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. This round fetched canonical main and checked 583 open PR bodies plus refreshed recent/updated records through PR3878, relevant actual sources, merged scope comparisons and partial Discussion HTML. The latest Gaussian expansion submission is recorded as a different pending route. No exhaustive novelty or predecessor-admission claim. The selected baseline binding check passes; the unrelated selected cold replay was not run.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/xor-endpoint-tapes
```
